scripts.typecheck: bun run cloudflare:config && bun run cf-typegen && next typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.preview: bun run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config .cloudflare/open-next/wrangler.json && wrangler dev --experimental-new-config
scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_BUILD_MODE=prod bun run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache remote --config .cloudflare/open-next/wrangler.json && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode prod
scripts.upload: CLOUDFLARE_BUILD_MODE=prod bun run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache remote --config .cloudflare/open-next/wrangler.json && cf workers versions create --prebuilt --mode prod
scripts.build:worker: bun run cloudflare:config && opennextjs-cloudflare build --config .cloudflare/open-next/wrangler.json && wrangler build --experimental-new-config --experimental-cf-build-output --env "${CLOUDFLARE_BUILD_MODE:-development}"
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run build:worker && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode development --dry-run
